entities.name: Conditional Presence Abbreviations
entities.description: Set of abbreviations used to specify the need for fields to be present in ASN.1 specifications. These define conditional presence rules and UE behavior for absent fields.

entities.name: Cond
entities.description: Conditionally present field. Presence is specified in a tabular form following the ASN.1 segment.

entities.name: CondC
entities.description: Configuration condition. Presence of the field is conditional to other configuration settings.

entities.name: CondM
entities.description: Message condition. Presence of the field is conditional to other fields included in the message.

entities.name: Need S
entities.description: Specified field. UE behavior is specified when field is absent (not if behavior is specified when field is not configured).

entities.name: Need M
entities.description: Maintain field. Stored by UE. Upon receiving message with field absent, UE maintains current value.

entities.name: Need N
entities.description: No action field. One-shot configuration not maintained. UE takes no action when field is absent.

entities.name: Need R
entities.description: Release field. Stored by UE. Upon receiving message with field absent, UE releases current value.
